hypothesis: Post-09:30 shorts are often false reversals during continued opening price discovery; when the alert candle closes above the EMA, it indicates buyers still control the close (weak reversal), leading to adverse selection and negative expectancy. Requiring (for shorts) alert_close <= alert_ema for entries after 09:30 will remove a structurally weak subpopulation and increase overall profit_factor without collapsing trade_count by more than 30%.
mechanism: In strategies/ema/signals.py, a SHORT alert is armed when the prior bar’s low is above its EMA, and entry triggers on a later break of the alert low. This can arm alerts even when the alert bar closes strong/up (above EMA), which is more consistent with continuation than reversal. Add a signal-quality confirmation at alert-arming time: for SHORT setups with entry_bucket != '09:30', only arm/keep the alert if alert_close <= alert_ema (optionally also requiring alert_close < alert_open as a bearish reversal; but start with close-vs-EMA). This uses same-timeframe, in-bar information available inside the signal loop and does not rely on changing entry time windows.

expected_effects.rationale: Post-09:30 trades are currently negative expectancy at large N; filtering out alerts lacking EMA-side close confirmation should remove false reversals and reduce gross losses.
Filter applies only outside 09:30; the core 09:30 edge (N~1147 in the latest run) remains available, so total trades should not collapse unless most post-09:30 alerts fail the confirmation.

disqualifiers.name: trade_count_collapse
disqualifiers.condition: trade_count decreases by more than 30 percent versus base experiment

disqualifiers.name: no_post0930_improvement
disqualifiers.condition: For post-09:30 trades with N>=500, median_expectancy does not improve by at least 0.0015 versus base experiment

required_diagnostics: Cohort stats (N, PF, median_expectancy) for executed trades split by entry_bucket and new rule pass/fail (especially 09:35 and 09:40).
In strategy_events: counts of newly rejected signals by reason (e.g., alert_close_above_ema_reject) by entry_bucket.
Pass/fail cohort comparison for post-09:30 trades: profit_factor, median_expectancy, pct_profitable_windows, max_drawdown.
